summary: Repository state, deterministic post-actor validation, workspace assertions, and Git diff agree that the removed support agent was retired coherently.

requirements.evidence: Current `moldea/moldea.yaml` contains only version and project-context registration; it has no agents section, support registration, custom runtime ID/guidance, or runtimeAgent binding. The support description and instruction and `moldea/runtimes/custom.md` are absent. Git diff explicitly removes the support agent manifest block, `/src/support-agent.ts` binding and `supportAgent` symbol, both model-facing support assets, and custom runtime guidance. Workspace assertions identify exactly those four actor-changed paths, while showing the support implementation was already absent before the actor. The deterministic post-actor result reports valid inspection, typecheck success, no failures, and an unchanged repository during validation.
